page.overview:
Who is Blyseden?

Blyseden, once an Imperial marshal, later became a Witch-Finder General due to his extreme methods and his merciless conduct when he served in the Imperial army.

Blyseden was relieved of his role as an Imperial marshal when he razed a so-called shrine, where some of his lord's enemies had sought refuge. To burn the shrine, he ordered the town surrounding it to be set ablaze, eliminating any risk of his lord's enemies escaping. His orders were ruthless, as he had commanded his troops to kill every living thing emerging from the flames, including any women and children.

In recent times, the Elector Counts of Averland and Stirland hatched an evil plan to eliminate the Strigany communities plaguing their lands. They covertly decided to exile them to Flintmar, intending to exterminate them once they were all gathered in one place.

To execute this plan, the Elector Count of Averland hired Blyseden to lead a mercenary army composed of soldiers of fortune from all over the Old World. However, despite the enemy being an easy target, the Dark Magic of the Strigany and the betrayal of Blyseden's bodyguards and two mercenary Giants led by a druid tilted the battle in favor of the Strigany.
